Subject: POC timeline & milestones - Acme Corp

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan so we can align on a kickoff next week: 

Success criteria (what Acme told us):
- Model accuracy for intent extraction >= 92% on your labelled sample set
- End-to-end latency (99th) under 400ms in US-West region for typical 512-token requests
- Integration work completed so the Acme platform can call the Redwood API and validate results automatically

Proposed evaluation plan / milestones:
1) Kickoff & data handoff (Day 0): confirm sample dataset, access, and success metric definitions.
2) Week 1: Baseline run with current model; deliver initial evaluation report and regression checklist.
3) Week 2: Tuning & quantization experiments; nightly runs and weekly checkpoint.
4) Week 3: Final validation, run on full eval suite, readout with stakeholders.

Owners / asks from Acme:
- Alex: provide the labelled evaluation set and the schema for success metrics by EOD Tue (6/30).
- Priya: confirm who will own test harness integration (API keys / endpoints) and a point of contact.

Redwood owners:
- Marissa (me): engagement lead / timeline coordinator
- Rishi: technical lead (model configs, runtime tuning)
- Naomi: CS lead for integration & support during the trial

Proposed timeline (flexible): kickoff 2026-07-01, weekly check-ins every Thursday 9:00am PT, final readout 2026-07-22. If that looks good I can send calendar invites and the SOW + evaluation plan.

Attachments: Draft POC SOW + evaluation plan attached for your review.

Next steps: please confirm kickoff date and that Alex / Priya can deliver the sample dataset by Tue (6/30).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap, this is helpful. High level: we like the plan. A couple quick clarifications: 

- We can get you the labelled set by Tue (6/30) EOD, but it'll be a filtered sample (about ~12k rows). Let us know if you need a specific CSV schema.
- For ownership: Priya will own the integration side and Tom will be our internal SRE contact for latency testing.
- Can we shift the weekly check-ins to Thursdays at 10:00am PT instead of 9:00am? That works better for our team.

I'll approve the draft SOW on our end once we align; if you can send calendar invites I'm good to lock in the kickoff.

Thanks Alex — great questions. Quick answers and next steps below.

- CSV schema: we'll accept the sample as-is; Rishi will validate columns and ping if anything's missing. If you can include a small README with column definitions that helps speed things up.
- Weekly check-ins: Thursday 10:00am PT works. I'll send invites for 7/1, 7/8, 7/15, and the readout on 7/22.
- Latency feasibility: cc'ing Rishi — see his note below.

Rishi's note (copied):
> From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
> Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
>
> Marissa / Alex —
> Based on the model family and the token distribution you described, 400ms 99th on our hosted plan is optimistic for 70B even with int8 quantization at typical concurrency. We recommend either:
> 1) Dedicated pool (2x A100-equivalent) which should meet the 400ms 99th in most runs, or
> 2) Accept a slightly higher tail (500-550ms) on hosted while we run perf tuning and prefix caching.
>
> For the POC I'd recommend starting on hosted to validate accuracy and integration; if latency is a hard requirement we can switch to a Dedicated trial for the performance phase.
>
> I'll prepare a short perf plan and cost delta to share in today's follow-up.
>
> Rishi
